title: Provenance record
description: Provenance for every factual claim in a function specification. Each claim must state its source category, date, author/agent, and the MATLAB release(s) it applies to (constitution.md §4).

schema_version.description: Version of THIS provenance document's format.

function_name.description: The function these provenance claims describe.

claims.description: One entry per factual claim referenced from the interface specification.

claim.description: Provenance for a single claim. source_category, date and applicable_releases are mandatory (constitution §4.2); the validator rejects entries missing any of them.

statement.description: The factual claim, in original wording. No copied documentation prose.

normative.description: Whether this claim imposes a normative requirement. Inferences must be non-normative (false) unless independently confirmed by observation.

date.description: ISO 8601 date the claim was recorded or last verified (YYYY-MM-DD).

author.description: Human author or agent responsible for the claim.

applicable_releases.description: MATLAB release(s) the claim pertains to, e.g. ['R2026a']. Required (constitution §4.2).

status.description: confirmed = directly observed/verified; pending = asserted but not yet verified; unresolved = flagged for review.

observation_refs.description: For black-box observations: references into specifications/<fn>/observations/ (file and case id).

source_citation.description: For external-permissively-licensed-fact: a citation to the permissively licensed source. Do not paste proprietary text here.

allOf.$comment: External facts must cite their source.

file.description: Path (relative to the function's spec dir) to an observations JSON file.

case_id.description: The case_id within that observations file.
